headline: Portfolio Outperformance Against SPY
summary: As of May 5, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 13.13% compared to SPY's 6.96%. This 6.18% alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, OpenAI 10, has delivered a return of 15.49%, contributing significantly to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, Random A, returned 8.31%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative strength during the current market conditions highlights the portfolio's resilience and effectiveness in navigating potential uncertainties. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
